description: Raindrop connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's saved Raindrop.io bookmarks as `raindrop:bookmark` items in the local index — the bookmarked URL, title, the excerpt/description, the user's note, the domain, the item type (link/article/image/video/document/audio), tags, the parent collection id, and the cover image. Useful for answering bookmarking questions ("what did I save about retries?", "find my bookmark on backpressure") without leaving Nimbus. Bearer API-token auth (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` — a Raindrop.io test token or OAuth access token; never logged). The SaaS host (api.raindrop.io) is fixed. Raindrop paginates the `/rest/v1/raindrops/0` endpoint by page number (0-based, page_size=50), returning the `{ result, items, count }` envelope. `created` / `lastUpdate` are ISO-8601 (converted to epoch-ms on index). Collections-as-items, highlights, and per-collection filtering are deferred follow-ups; v1 indexes bookmarks only.
author: Nimbus
